title: FIGHT IN A HOUSE SCRIPT KEYLESS
script:
-- I-paste ito sa iyong Madium Executor habang nasa loob ng laro

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Siguraduhing burado ang lumang bersyon upang hindi mag-overlap
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("HouseFightNoCD") then
	CoreGui.HouseFightNoCD:Destroy()
end

-- ========================================================
-- 1. PREMIUM MODERN DARK GUI (May Dark Neon Theme at Smooth Borders)
-- ========================================================
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "HouseFightNoCD"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 270, 0, 170)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -135, 0.5, -85)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 22)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local FrameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FrameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
FrameCorner.Parent = MainFrame

-- Rainbow Stroke / Borders (Lahat ng guhit ay may rainbow)
local FrameStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
FrameStroke.Thickness = 2.5
FrameStroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- TOP TITLE BAR
local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 32)
TopBar.Parent = MainFrame

local TopBarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TopBarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
TopBarCorner.Parent = TopBar

local TopBarStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
TopBarStroke.Thickness = 1.5
TopBarStroke.Parent = TopBar

local TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
TitleLabel.Text = "HOUSE FIGHT MULTIHACK V3"
TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleLabel.TextSize = 13
TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleLabel.Parent = TopBar

-- DELETE BUTTON (Top Right "X")
local DeleteBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
DeleteBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
DeleteBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.5, -12)
DeleteBtn.Text = "×"
DeleteBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DeleteBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 75, 75)
DeleteBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
DeleteBtn.TextSize = 18
DeleteBtn.Parent = TopBar

local DeleteCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
DeleteCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
DeleteCorner.Parent = DeleteBtn

-- TOGGLE BUTTON HOLDER
local ToggleContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
ToggleContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 55)
ToggleContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.5, -5)
ToggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 36)
ToggleContainer.Parent = MainFrame

local ContainerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ContainerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
ContainerCorner.Parent = ToggleContainer

local ContainerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
ContainerStroke.Thickness = 2
ContainerStroke.Parent = ToggleContainer

-- THE TOGGLE BUTTON (Enable/Disable)
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
ToggleBtn.Text = "NO COOLDOWN: DISABLED"
ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ToggleBtn.TextSize = 15
ToggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ToggleBtn.Parent = ToggleContainer

-- ========================================================
-- 2. ALL GUHIT RAINBOW ENGINE (Smooth Rainbow Loop)
-- ========================================================
task.spawn(function()
	while ScreenGui.Parent do
		local hue = (tick() % 5) / 5
		local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
		FrameStroke.Color = rainbowColor
		TopBarStroke.Color = rainbowColor
		ContainerStroke.Color = rainbowColor
		task.wait()
	end
end)

-- ========================================================
-- 3. UNIVERSAL NO COOLDOWN ENGINE
-- ========================================================
local _G = _G or {}
_G.NoCooldownActive = false

-- Method A: Pwersahang pagbura sa itinakdang delay attributes/values ng weapon ng laro
local function removeToolCooldown(tool)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
	
	-- Tinatanggal ang karaniwang config values ng cooldown
	local cooldownVal = tool:FindFirstChild("Cooldown") or tool:FindFirstChild("Delay") or tool:FindFirstChild("Rate")
	if cooldownVal and (cooldownVal:IsA("NumberValue") or cooldownVal:IsA("IntValue")) then
		cooldownVal.Value = 0
	end
	
	-- Binabago ang attributes kung doon nakasave ang cooldown
	if tool:GetAttribute("Cooldown") then tool:SetAttribute("Cooldown", 0) end
	if tool:GetAttribute("Delay") then tool:SetAttribute("Delay", 0) end
	if tool:GetAttribute("AttackSpeed") then tool:SetAttribute("AttackSpeed", 100) end
end

-- Patuloy na pag-scan sa mga hawak na gamit o kamao
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1) -- Swak sa Madium para iwas lag
		if _G.NoCooldownActive then
			pcall(function()
				local char = LocalPlayer.Character
				if char then
					-- Para sa kasalukuyang hawak na tool o fists
					local holdingTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
					if holdingTool then
						removeToolCooldown(holdingTool)
					end
					
					-- Para naman sa mga nasa backpack pa na hindi pa hinahawakan
					for _, tool in pairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
						removeToolCooldown(tool)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end)

-- Method B: Fast Click Hook (Kapag pinindot ang mouse, tuloy-tuloy ang atake nang walang delay)
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and _G.NoCooldownActive then
		-- Habang nakapindot ang mouse, magpapadala ito ng sunod-sunod na activation signal
		while UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and _G.NoCooldownActive do
			pcall(function()
				local tool = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
				if tool then
					tool:Activate() -- Pwersahang pinapalo ang tool/fists nang mabilis
				end
			end)
			task.wait(0.01) -- Ang bilis ng spam clicks
		end
	end
end)

-- TOGGLE MECHANICS
ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	_G.NoCooldownActive = not _G.NoCooldownActive
	
	if _G.NoCooldownActive then
		ToggleBtn.Text = "NO COOLDOWN: ACTIVE"
		TweenService:Create(ToggleBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 80)}):Play()
	else
		ToggleBtn.Text = "NO COOLDOWN: DISABLED"
		TweenService:Create(ToggleBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)}):Play()
	end
end)

-- DELETE / DESTROY BUTTON MECHANICS
DeleteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	_G.NoCooldownActive = false
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Roblox LocalScript: Compact Cyborg Shift Run GUI (Fight in a House)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local toggleOn = false
local isShifting = false
local speedMultiplier = 0.35 -- Ang saktong tulin ng Cyborg Style. Lakasan kung gusto mo pang mas mabilis.

-- 1. ScreenGui Setup
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "CyborgShiftGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local success, err = pcall(function()
    screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end)
if not success then screenGui.Parent = CoreGui end

-- 2. Main Frame (Saktong-sakto ang laki, napakaliit at malinis)
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 130) -- Sobrang saktong sukat para hindi sagabal
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.4, -65)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
mainCorner.Parent = mainFrame

-- 3. Rainbow Border (Lahat ng gilid ay may umiikot na kulay)
local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
uiStroke.Thickness = 3
uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
uiStroke.Parent = mainFrame

coroutine.wrap(function()
    while true do
        for hue = 0, 1, 0.002 do
            uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            task.wait(0.01)
        end
    end
end)()

-- 4. Title Text (Madaling basahin, may Outline)
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 35)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = "CYBORG SHIFT RUN"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
titleLabel.TextSize = 18 -- Malaki at malinaw
titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
titleLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame

-- 5. Delete Button (X sa Itaas)
local deleteButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
deleteButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
deleteButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 10)
deleteButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 50, 50)
deleteButton.Text = "X"
deleteButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
deleteButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
deleteButton.TextSize = 16
deleteButton.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
deleteButton.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
deleteButton.Parent = mainFrame

local deleteCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
deleteCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
deleteCorner.Parent = deleteButton

deleteButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- 6. Toggle Button (ON / OFF Status)
local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 50)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.5, 12)
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50) -- Pulang Simula
toggleButton.Text = "STATUS: OFF"
toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
toggleButton.TextSize = 22 -- Pinalaki ang text para kitang-kita agad
toggleButton.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
toggleButton.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
toggleButton.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleButton

-- 7. Toggle Logic (Pindutan para i-activate ang hack)
toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    toggleOn = not toggleOn
    
    if toggleOn then
        toggleButton.Text = "STATUS: ON"
        toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) -- Berde pag gumagana
    else
        toggleButton.Text = "STATUS: OFF"
        toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50) -- Pula pag patay
    end
end)

-- 8. Detection para sa Shift Key (Shift Run Detection)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        isShifting = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        isShifting = false
    end
end)

-- 9. Execution Loop (Gagana lang kapag Naka-ON ang Status at Naka-pindot ang Shift)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if toggleOn and isShifting then
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            
            -- Kung naglalakad ang player habang nakapindot ang Shift, bibigyan ng Cyborg Speed bypass
            if rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + (humanoid.MoveDirection * speedMultiplier)
            end
        end
    end
end)
features:
tool no cooldown
speed run using dragon style
